name: -10 AN Male to -10 AN Female Extender
description:
ColorFittings -10AN Male to -10AN Female Extenders are precision CNC-machined to extend AN connections while maintaining a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal. Ideal for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering systems, these extenders provide additional clearance for tight engine bays, custom plumbing, and performance applications.
Manufactured from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process, these AN extenders offer superior strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. The precision-machined 37-degree AN flare seats ensure a reliable seal in high-pressure and high-temperature environments.
Compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuel, pump gas, diesel, oil, coolant, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, and air systems, these AN extension fittings are perfect for street performance, racing, off-road, marine, and custom fabrication projects.
Looking to complete your system? Explore our full range of AN fittings, metric adapters, braided hose, and fitting assembly tools.
